description: This file defines the AuthProvider class, a ChangeNotifier that manages authentication state, including login, logout, and session restoration logic, interacting with AuthRepository and SecurePrefs.

classes.name: AuthProvider
classes.description: Manages authentication state, handling login, logout, and session initialization, notifying UI components of state changes.

methods.name: AuthProvider
methods.description: Constructor allowing optional injection of an AuthRepository, defaulting to a new instance.

methods.name: initialize
methods.description: Restores authentication state by checking for existing token and user info in persistent storage.

methods.name: login
methods.description: Performs login with provided credentials, updating user state and notifying listeners.

methods.name: logout
methods.description: Clears authentication data, both locally and remotely, and notifies listeners.
